content:
The **Helvetia Town Hall** is a building within the Appalachian town of Helvetia.

Located on Pickens Road and west of the Helvetia Hotel, it is a small one-story building. It has a back entrance and contains six Vote Counters, a Duffle Bag and a Cooler on a table, as well as several playable instruments, including a Banjo, Steel Guitar and an Upright piano.

The Helvetia Town Hall appears in *Fallout 76*.
